analysis_set.span: Full analysis set (FAS) defined as all randomized participants who received at least 1 dose of intranasal study medication, 1 dose of oral antidepressant (AD) medication during double-blind induction phase (D-BIP).

follow_up.span: Baseline up to Day 28 of Double-blind Induction Phase

entry_age.span: At the time of signing the informed consent form (ICF), participant must be a man or woman 18 (or older if the minimum legal age of consent in the country in which the study is taking place is greater than \[\>\]18) to 64 years of age, inclusive

notes: Result outcome 0 defines FAS and specifies that N counts evaluable participants; the served raw means use 101 versus 100 observed cases. Eligibility describes a subset of adults with treatment-resistant depression, with no entry criterion placing them outside the question. No held_local HTML full text is present in the supplied packet; evidence comes from the supplied registry text.
